title: Application holds high-impact Microsoft Graph write permissions

approvedApplicationIds.text: Service-principal object IDs for approved administrative applications in this tenant

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application holds', 'applications hold')} high-impact Graph write permissions

messages.businessImpact: These application permissions can change directory objects, privileged role membership, application credentials or API grants without a person signing in. A compromised application credential can therefore increase access across the tenant.
remediation: Confirm each application's owner, purpose and continued need for every listed permission.
Remove broad write grants where a narrower permission or read-only access is sufficient.
List approved administrative applications by service-principal object ID in this tenant's rule override.
messages.cannotSee: Requires the optional Application.Read.All permission; without it this check is skipped. It reads Microsoft Graph application-permission grants, not an application's credentials, activity or directory-role assignments. The approvedApplicationIds list is a tenant decision and is empty until configured.
